description: This PHP source file defines the class SuiteEditorDirectHTML, which implements the SuiteEditorInterface. The class provides a method to set up editor settings and a method to generate HTML output using the Smarty templating engine. The file also includes licensing information and an access restriction at the top.

classes.name: SuiteEditorDirectHTML
classes.description: A class implementing SuiteEditorInterface that provides methods for setting up editor settings and rendering HTML using Smarty templates.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the SuiteEditorDirectHTML object with optional SuiteEditorSettings.

methods.name: getHtml
methods.description: Generates HTML output for the editor by rendering a Smarty template with the current settings.
